en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with cobblestone pavement. A tall clock tower with a bulbous spire and cross stands prominently to the left, attached to an older stone structure. In the background on a slightly higher elevation is a large building with multiple small towers, resembling a castle or palace. On the right side is a building with painted signage reading "Hôtel Stadt D…" and smaller German text below, indicating a hotel and restaurant. On the left is another building with shop fronts, one labeled "Möbel‑Magazin" and "Ernst Voigtländer & Söhne". A hanging sign in the foreground reads "Zum … Haus". A few people are visible walking in the open square and one man in a hat stands at the left edge.
